description: This file defines an abstraction over a notes database with implementations for different platforms, including a web fallback. It includes classes for database initialization, change notification, and in-memory database emulation for web.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: Main interface for database operations, choosing implementation based on platform.

classes.name: _NotesDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining database implementation contract.

classes.name: _SqfliteNotesDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Platform-specific implementation for native and desktop using sqflite.

classes.name: _InMemoryNotesDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Web fallback implementation with in-memory database.

classes.name: _FakeWebDatabase
classes.description: Minimal in-memory database mimicking sqflite API for web.

classes.name: _FakeWebBatch
classes.description: Batch operations for the in-memory web database.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that returns the database instance asynchronously.

methods.name: notifyChanged
methods.description: Method to notify listeners of a change.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes database connection and cleans up resources.
